lines.en: I fly toward that light.
My wings are thin.
I drift through the hollow valley.
I fly all over the place.
My shadow is on the stone wall.
I circle your torch.
My body holds only a few drops of life.
I settle on the rock.
I shed scale dust as I fly.
The wind spun me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀几乎没有声音
lines.en: My wings are nearly silent.
I head for something brighter.
I swing around a stalactite.
I do not fly very high.
I skim the ground.
I look for warm light.
I rest on stone.
My wings are folded.
I sit still in the light.
My antennae sway gently.
I have no strength to attack.
I wait for other insects to pass.
A little scale dust fell.
I look up at that light.
I am so light the wind moves me.
I hide in a rock seam.
My flight makes no sound either.
I count the moths passing.
My body glows faintly.
I press against the warm stone.
Your torch is so bright.

lines.zh: 我循着你的火把飘过来
lines.en: I drift toward you, following your torch
I will not hurt you.
There is a glow around you.
Your lamp drew me.
Do not bring your hand down.
I only want to be near light.
Your light moves with each step.
I rest on your cuff
You are very warm.
A wing split at the edge.
My wings go slack and I drop to the floor
My scale dust scattered.
Scales are dropping off my wings.
I cannot cry; I have no voice.
My flight pulls to one side.
I am not dead yet.
That blow was heavy.
I hide in a crack.
I can barely keep flying.
I do not touch that.
What I want is that light.
Is that bright in your hand?

lines.zh: 这味道里一点光都没有
lines.en: There is no light in that smell at all
It does not glow at all.
Try holding it higher.
I circle it once.
That is not nectar at all.
Put away anything that does not glow
I have flown back to the light.
Touch me and I veer.
I am too light to make a sound.
My scales are on you.
I dropped a little.
You nearly swatted me.
I dodge your hand.
Barely a touch.
I settle on a nearby stone.
Your breath moves me.
Do not swat at me with your hand.
I have only days.
I am looking for the same wings.
There are many like me in the light.
You are blocking that light.

lines.zh: 我朝鳞粉味那边飘过去
lines.en: I drift toward the smell of scale dust
This season is very short.

lines.zh: 我们不落在同一块石头上
lines.en: We do not share the same stone.
Do not follow along behind me.

lines.zh: 那边的鳞粉味和我一样
lines.en: That scale dust smells like mine
I have flown into the dark.
I cannot lift things.
These legs of mine are too thin.
I settle beside it.
It is blocking the light.
I fly over it.
This thing is quite heavy.
One bend and you have it.
I would only dirty it.
It reflects; I saw it.
I would only dirty myself.
It is that bright light.
I flutter straight at that speck of light
What I fix on is not a living thing.
I only need to get near.
The lamp in your hand is bright.
I circle once before landing.
I head for the brightest point.
Right at that spot.
I have taken flight.
Do not put the light away.
I follow your torch.
You went far; the light shrank.

lines.zh: 我顺着火光绕回你跟前
lines.en: I circle back to you along your torchlight
I land on your lamp's cover.
Where you go, the light goes.
This little heat does not bother me.
I keep circling you.
You raised your hand; the light swayed.
I follow the light's edge.
I can fly a little longer.
I bump into your forehead.
I have no strength at all.
My wing brushed your eye.

lines.zh: 我撞一下你也几乎没感觉
lines.en: I bump you and you hardly feel it
Your palm brushed me aside.
I circle around your eyes.
I did not come to fight you.
The air pushed me down.
I circled back and hit again.
I am truly sorry.
I fly out of a rock seam.
The light drew me here.

lines.zh: 空谷里有很多我这样的
lines.en: There are many like me in the hollow valley.
My wings are not dry yet.
I settle on warm stone.
I made one loop around you.
It should not be this bright here.

lines.zh: 我闻到了捕食者的味道
lines.en: I smell a predator.
I fly toward the light.
Do not put the lamp out.

lines.zh: 火太近了，我的翅膀卷了
lines.en: The fire is too near; my wings curled.
I fell from above.
My wings are completely soaked.

lines.zh: 一股气浪把我拍在岩壁上
lines.en: A blast wave slaps me onto the cave wall
An arrow grazed my wing.
The spell put out my glow.
I have no strength to feed.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮了，我什么也看不见
lines.en: The flash blinds me.
There is no light here at all.
